findings.defect: Manual recovery is not constrained to the default-branch control revision even though discovery and design require corrected controls from main.
findings.evidence: GitHub Actions permits workflow_dispatch against another ref; R6.2 rejects only a run without an explicit tag, while the select interface and task fixtures contain no control-ref/default-branch check.
findings.proposed_fix: Add an EARS criterion requiring refs/heads/main for manual recovery, pass and verify the dispatch ref/default branch before image validation, add a non-main rejection fixture, and require --ref main in the operator command.

findings.defect: The design and task plan classify new required CI dependencies as dependency-resolution none.
findings.evidence: The feature selects actions/setup-python, CPython 3.12.11, pytest 8.4.2, and Playwright 1.61.0 for a required merge gate; dependency-evidence.md applies whenever a feature selects or integrates a material third-party dependency.
findings.proposed_fix: Make the CI task dependency-resolution change, own the workflow resolution path, and record/review ordered pre-change and post-change dependency-security-audit evidence with exact versions and linked reports.

findings.defect: The design claims all actions retain full commit pins, but the existing CI workflow uses mutable action and toolchain refs and the task says to retain that job.
findings.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml currently uses actions/checkout@v7, dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable, and Swatinem/rust-cache@v2; task 2.1 explicitly pins only the new setup-python action.
findings.proposed_fix: Resolve, review, and full-SHA-pin every uses reference in ci.yml, record current identities, and add a verification that rejects non-SHA action refs.

findings.defect: The recovery sequence diagram joins both platform results before attestation, contradicting the per-platform attestation contract in R5.1 and the design prose.
findings.evidence: The diagram shows both platforms upload, then a combined gate allows attestation and publication; the prose requires each clean platform to enforce its own report and attest before final publication joins both legs.
findings.proposed_fix: Revise the flow IR and sequence so upload, enforce, and attest occur independently in each platform branch, followed by a both-successful join at publication; render-validate the revision.

findings.defect: The vulnerability helper validates only that matches is an array, not that each finding contains the actionable fields required by R4.4.
findings.evidence: The design accepts any matches array, so a report containing an empty object can be summarized instead of rejected as malformed under R4.6.
findings.proposed_fix: Define and fixture-test required Grype field types for identifier, severity, artifact, installed version, and fix-version array; render none available for an empty valid fix list and reject missing or wrong-typed fields.

findings.defect: The task sidecar records three spec-state ownership paths without their .specs prefix.
findings.evidence: The Markdown link targets resolve under .specs, but the link labels parsed into 04_tasks.json are containerized-service/00_state.md, amtrak-gtfs-rt-service/00_state.md, and advisory-fetcher/00_state.md.
findings.proposed_fix: Use project-root-relative .specs path labels while retaining correct relative targets, regenerate the sidecar, and verify every sidecar file exists or is explicitly planned.

findings.defect: The release-context test contract omits a positive verify fixture that proves exact full-SHA emission and a failing metadata fixture.
findings.evidence: The design requires revision equal to TAG^{commit}, but its enumerated fixtures cover selection and mismatch failures without asserting the successful revision output or proving tagged metadata validation is invoked.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a passing tagged-checkout fixture asserting the 40-character revision equals git rev-parse TAG^{commit}, plus a tagged metadata failure fixture.

findings.defect: The task plan authorizes stage-2 concurrency even though only task 2.1 is parallel-safe and task 2.2 is controller-owned.
findings.evidence: The plan warning allows concurrency only when every participant is parallel-safe, while the delivery schedule says tasks 2.1 and 2.2 may proceed concurrently.
findings.proposed_fix: Remove the concurrency authorization and execute stage 2 serially under the current delegation metadata.

findings.defect: The EARS boundary does not explicitly preserve discovery's requirement that current documentation identify both PR #8 and PR #9 as merged and contain no contradictory status claim.
findings.evidence: Discovery names both PRs in its success measure; R7.1 describes their source outcomes without naming either PR, and task 3.1 explicitly mentions only the stale PR #8 claim.
findings.proposed_fix: Make R7.1 and the documentation verification explicitly name PRs #8 and #9 and reject contradictory current-state claims.

findings.defect: The immutable tagged smoke harness may run its own scanner before the planned canonical Syft/Grype evidence pass, causing duplicate scans and differing database snapshots.
findings.evidence: scripts/test-container.sh always enters an image-evidence section and uses Docker Scout or Grype when available; the actual scanner chosen depends on hosted-runner tool availability.
findings.validation_method: Record hosted-runner scanner availability and command traces; explicitly distinguish best-effort smoke-harness evidence from the single canonical Grype JSON used by the policy, or define a safe tag-compatible smoke-only strategy.

risk_register.risk: A non-main control revision obtains release write permissions
risk_register.mitigation: Reject manual dispatch unless the control ref is refs/heads/main before platform jobs start.

risk_register.risk: Malformed vulnerability findings are retained but not actionable
risk_register.mitigation: Validate every required Grype match field and fail closed with fixtures.

risk_register.risk: Mutable CI action refs change required checks unexpectedly
risk_register.mitigation: Use reviewed full commit pins and dependency-audit evidence.

risk_register.risk: Sequence documentation authorizes a different attestation order than implementation
risk_register.mitigation: Model per-platform upload, enforce, and attest before the publication join.

risk_register.risk: Hosted registry or attestation behavior differs from local structural checks
risk_register.mitigation: Keep feature-branch recovery disabled and treat the reviewed GitHub run as the integration authority after merge.

risk_register.risk: Duplicate scanner passes waste time or use different vulnerability databases
risk_register.mitigation: Identify one canonical policy report and verify hosted scanner availability and ordering.
